description: Dependency updates arrive as pull requests from the hosted Renovate app (root ADR-0271).

Version pins live in tools/technology-versions.contract.json (root ADR-0097): the custom managers below update the contract in the same branch as every file that copies a pin, so the version guards see one value.

Patch and digest updates and lockfile maintenance open ready pull requests with GitHub's auto-merge on, which adds them to the merge queue once CI is green (root ADR-0585); minor and major (non-security) updates open as drafts for a person to review.
Security (vulnerability) updates automerge once CI is green, even a major: the vulnerability risk outweighs the regression risk and CI is the gate (ADR-0302 amends ADR-0097 for security only).
The dependency dashboard is one issue listing pending, blocked and rate-limited updates, with the manual-run checkbox (root ADR-0568 8).

Python pins are the uv-compiled requirements.txt files (their header names the uv pip compile command): the pip-compile manager moves the direct pins of the requirements.in beside each and regenerates the hashed file, so security fixes reach them too.

customManagers.description: JS pins in the version contract; the npm manager updates the package.json copies in the same branch.
Container images in the version contract, repository:tag -> digest.
The Spark version the lakehouse engine contract names is the apache/spark image one (the Spark runtime test asserts they are equal), so it moves in the same group branch as the image copies.
Every copy of a pinned image reference, the same pattern scripts/catalog/sync-container-images.py checks against the contract.

packageRules.description: Runtime and toolchain moves are their own wave with full re-verification (root ADR-0097 decision 1).
pnpm overrides are rendered from tools/npm/security-overrides.contract.json into each tree's pnpm-workspace.yaml (root ADR-0158, ADR-0572), not edited.
pnpm-workspace.yaml holds the rendered overrides and the reviewed allowBuilds (root ADR-0572); a fix moves the contract, not this file.
Third-party actions are admitted by exact SHA in tools/github/selected-actions.json and the live Actions allowlist; that list moves first.
A major moves one dependency at a time, in a draft (root ADR-0097 decision 1).
